public.title: Next Permutation
public.description: Return the next lexicographic permutation of the input integer sequence. If no larger permutation exists, return ascending order. There are 0 to 1000 integers from -1000 to 1000; duplicates are allowed. Return an array; mutation is optional.
hints: Locate the rightmost ascent, increase it minimally, and reverse the suffix.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The descending suffix is already maximal. Swap its pivot with the smallest larger suffix value, then reverse the suffix for the minimal continuation. O(n) time.
